scripts.build:android:dev: ionic build --configuration=development && npx @capacitor/assets generate && npx cap sync && npx cap copy android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:android:prod: ionic build --configuration=production && npx @capacitor/assets generate && npx cap sync && npx cap copy android && npx cap open android
scripts.apk:dev: ionic build --configuration=development && npx @capacitor/assets generate && npx cap sync && npx cap copy android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && npx cap open android
scripts.apk:prod: ionic build --configuration=production && npx @capacitor/assets generate && npx cap sync && npx cap copy android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease && cd .. && npx cap open android
